title: A Debt in Transit
summary: A dying traveller pressed a sealed letter into your hands. Someone, somewhere, is waiting for it.

objectives.text: Deliver it to the addressee at the shrine

title: Extend the Guild's Reach
summary: Footholds win the frontier. Secure staging points so future expeditions strike deeper into the unknown.

objectives.text: Hold three secured sites across the world

title: Chronicle the Unknown
summary: Knowledge is the guild's true treasury. Record what the world has forgotten.

title: Restore the Sixfold Seal
summary: Six archmages bound the Outer Void behind a Sixfold Seal, one fragment to each school. The seal is failing. Recover all six before the Convergence unmakes the world.

title: The Primal Shard
summary: A rumour surfaced in a drowned archive: the Elementalist's fragment sleeps in the heart of a storm that never ends.

objectives.text: Learn of the Shard's binding (drowned archive)
Chart a course into the eternal storm

title: The Axiom Stone

objectives.text: Uncover the rumour of the Axiom Stone
